children: There's a tendency among financial market economists to immediately launch a strident defense of their existing calls on interest rates, even in the face of shocking inflation data. Inflation rose 4.9% in October and core inflation also climbed. It might be the case that the Reserve Bank of Australia chooses to ride out the bad news and keep the official cash rate on hold. Still, it wasn't that long ago that the central bank was highlighting the fury of consumers about elevated prices, and sending out warnings that high inflation expectations are becoming embedded. RBA Governor Bullock speaks on Tuesday. It is going to be a critical address. (james.glynn@wsj.com; @JamesGlynnWSJ)
